passages.title: Digital Literacy: Checking Online Claims
passages.text: An image circulated in a class chat claiming that Monday’s examination had been cancelled. The image used the school logo but included no date and no link to an original notice. Several students immediately shared it. Dira checked the school’s official website and found a notice saying that the examination would begin one hour later, not that it was cancelled. She sent the official link to her classmates and reminded them to check dates and sources before forwarding urgent messages.
